draft.hypothesis: The repeated target-test failure occurs because the agent edits code without first inspecting the relevant tests, causing blind patch attempts and failed target assertions.
draft.expected_effect: Encouraging test inspection before editing should clarify expected behavior, reduce blind patch iterations, and lower target-test failure frequency.
draft.possible_risk: If tests are not available or are expensive to inspect, the agent may spend extra steps before editing; the soft 'prefer' setting should still allow progress when tests cannot be accessed.
